athlete_facing_breakdown.one_thing_to_focus_on_next: Work on creating more separation before pulling up. In the clip, your crossover got you into the shot but didn't fully clear the defender — the result was a block. The goal is to make the defender's feet move first, then use your pull-up as a true advantage shot, not a contested one.
athlete_facing_breakdown.drill_recommendation: Drill: 'Two-Dribble Pull-Up Series' — Start at the elbow, use a hard jab or shot-fake to shift the defender's weight, then take exactly two dribbles (one direction change) into your pull-up. Focus on the moment of separation — only shoot when you feel the defender's momentum going the wrong way. Do 10 reps from each elbow daily, tracking how many reps you get a clean release versus a contested one.

athlete_facing_breakdown.one_thing_to_focus_on_next: The film only shows you with the ball in your hands. Scouts need to see what you do WITHOUT the ball — your cuts, your relocations, and especially your defense. That's what separates prospects at the next level.
athlete_facing_breakdown.drill_recommendation: Spend dedicated time on 'ghost cuts' and 'read-and-replace' off-ball drills. Film yourself making back-cuts and flare-cuts off a passer, then review the footage to check your timing and angles. Pair this with 1-on-1 closeout defense reps so you have defensive film to share with evaluators.

what_youre_doing_well: Your hesitation dribble is a genuine weapon — you shifted the defender's weight and created real space before the pull-up.
Your crossover-to-fadeaway shows you have more than one move; the footwork into the shot looks natural and practiced.
You're showing confidence releasing over a defender rather than forcing your way to the rim, which speaks to your shot-creation IQ.
athlete_facing_breakdown.one_thing_to_focus_on_next: The film only shows you creating off isolation. The next step is proving you can make the right read when the defense collapses — find the open teammate, then get back to your own shot. Decision-making in advantage situations will separate you at the next level.
athlete_facing_breakdown.drill_recommendation: 3-Man Advantage Drill: Start in a 3-on-2 half-court set. You initiate off the dribble, read the defense, and must make at least two passes before shooting. This forces you to process multiple options before defaulting to your own shot, building the passing IQ and off-ball awareness that scouts will look for in your next evaluation.
